reviews.text:
Nigel was excellent! We can’t recommend him highly enough. He came to see me, my mum and my partner for a puppy consultation with our 9-week-old Rottweiler, Rani, and we all left feeling so confident and at ease with her.

Rottweilers are wonderful, loyal dogs, but they're often unfairly misunderstood, and we're very aware that a large, powerful dog who hasn't been raised well can face serious consequences. We want Rani to be a great ambassador for her breed, so getting things right from the very beginning really mattered to us. That's why this consultation was so important.

Nigel started with a detailed theory session that was engaging and very informative. Helping us to also understand our responsibility in how we react and interact with her. He was so friendly and approachable, and happily answered all our questions along the way. Throughout the session, he took every opportunity to show us how to respond whenever Rani got a bit cheeky or started chewing and biting things, so we could see his approach in action straight away. And it was so impressive to see how quickly she responded to his methods first with him, and then most reassuringly with us. We then moved on to a practical session, which brought everything together and gave us the confidence to put it into practice ourselves.

Nigel also gave us a copy of his book, access to his videos, and lifelong support whenever we need him. Knowing we can reach out to him as Rani grows is incredibly reassuring.

As an experienced behaviourist, Nigel focuses on building the right relationship rather than just teaching commands, and that's exactly what we needed. He gave us the perfect foundation to raise a happy, beautifully behaved dog in the years ahead.

Thank you, Nigel. We feel so well prepared for the journey ahead with Rani!

Nigel was incredible with our senior beagle, whose behaviour had got tricker post recovery from a big operation. Two hours with Nigel has transformed our lives and our dogs - he's a wizard. Can't believe we left it so long. Training only took a few days to reach impact and a week or two in, we haven't looked back.

Found Nigel online to help us understand our dog’s behaviour, what it means, and how to address it. Nigel was fantastic, came to our home, saw our dog in her own habitat to get a proper understanding of her. We went through the theory, then he took us out to show us how to put it into practice. After just a few days we’ve already seen a difference in how we approach walks, and some real improvements. Highly recommend!

Nigel was fantastic! I was surprised that within the first 10 minutes of the consultation, he was able to stop my dog from barking when I open any of the cupboards in the kitchen. Nigel was honest, direct and thoughtful to our context. I feel like I now have a better relationship with my dog and the dog is so much better. I've not regretted a single penny! Highly highly recommend.

Nigel was incredibly helpful with training our Cocker Spaniel, Maya. He took the time to listen to the issues we were having, explained the fundamentals of a dog’s needs, and quickly identified the root causes of Maya’s behaviour. He provided a clear, detailed training plan and demonstrated exactly how to implement it. Just two weeks after our consultation, we’ve already seen a significant improvement in Maya’s behaviour. We’d highly recommend Nigel to anyone looking for knowledgeable and practical dog training.

My wife and I can't recommend Nigel highly enough. He was suggested to us by our local vet, and from the moment he came round to the flat, the difference was immediate. Just a couple of the actions he recommended and our boy Bryn's behaviour had already turned around, especially the over-excitement when people come through the door.
Walking him is honestly a dream now too. He used to pull and tug the whole way, and now he walks right alongside us, constantly checking in to see where we are. We're still working through the rest of what Nigel's recommended, building up Bryn's confidence bit by bit.
We can't thank him enough, and we'll be recommending him to anyone we know who wants a better bond with their dog.

Nigel came to help us with our 2 yr old cocker spaniel who was barking a lot at the front door and in the garden, as well as at other dogs when on walks with us. Previous trainers had helped us with distraction techniques to manage it but in the city you can’t always avoid and Nigel’s approach is treating the underlying issue not just the symptoms.
We’ve seen massive improvements since implementing Nigel’s methods. The biggest difference is that we don’t spend our walks scanning for potential risks. We have a clear and simple plan to show our dog everything is OK, instead of trying to distract and avoid. We are more confident and so is our dog as a result. Nigel’s approach has been easy to adapt to different circumstances and we continue to be surprised at how much more settled our dog is from a few small but consistent changes! Thank you Nigel!
We’re very impressed with how quickly we’re seeing results of the dog training. I couldn’t recommend Nigel’s methods enough!

Nigel came and met with my wife and me in our home and talked with us one-on-one about our specific situation and how to correct all the bad behaviours with our dog, Luke. He pulled on the lead, and was very aggressive with other dogs. Now we're about a month into the training and it's going fabulously. Moreover, we've learned how to relate to our dog in a healthy way (as a leader). He's so much better on the lead, and becoming calmer with other dogs every day. I'm addicted to training him! We're eagerly looking forward to the day when all his training pays off--getting closer all the time! Would highly recommend Nigel!
Nigel was brilliant. For the first time we actually understand what we need to do to help our dog.

We had a behavioral issue with our dog (Westie), who would bark excessively at any visitors in the house, and we struggled to control her. We decided to seek advice from Nigel, whose dog training approach seemed very interesting.
Nigel provided training for our dog and explained in detail how to handle situations like this, helping her to return the responsibility for security back to us. His approach proved to be highly effective - not only did her behavior with visitors improve significantly, but issues such as fussiness with food, pulling on the lead, and constantly seeking attention also greatly diminished.
We are extremely pleased with Nigel’s training and would definitely recommend him to anyone looking to improve their relationship with their dog in a thoughtful and effective way.

In a space of a few hours Charlies behaviour changed mainly thanks to me being more aware of how I should handle his fear. I have been practising outside since and have noticed vast improvements in my dog's confidence and reactivity. Couldn't reccomend it more !

I really can’t recommend Nigel highly enough. After only 2 hours, we noticed a significant difference in our 2 year old dog who used to pick and choose when he would listen to us or not. It was quite incredible. We came away with not only practical tools to train our dog, but also a whole new mindset. Unlike other trainers, his approach is faster, firmer and clearer whilst still being kind and flexible to each dogs needs. The ongoing support is also fantastic. Thanks so much.

Nigel has been an incredible help with my two-year-old Golden Retriever. After just one week, I noticed real progress in my dog’s behaviour — less pulling, reduced aggression, and more confidence around other dogs. During our four-hour session, Nigel clearly explained his training methods and shared valuable tips to help me better understand and manage my dog both at home and outdoors. To reinforce everything we covered, he also provided several useful resources, including a copy of his book, detailed notes, flow charts, and videos. Overall, it was a very positive experience.

We can’t recommend Nigel highly enough. Buddy, our 3-year-old Bernese Mountain Dog, used to be a little anxious and had tendencies to react when on lead (jumping and barking), along with some other small things we wanted to work on with him. After working with Nigel, the change has been amazing.

Nigel had a very calm and patient approach with both Buddy and us. He took the time to give us clear and practical advice, especially when it came to helping us understand how to grow Buddy’s confidence at home and outside.

It’s been a really rewarding experience seeing Buddy progress within a month of us following Nigel’s advice. We immediately saw positive changes in Buddy’s behaviour and can see he is much calmer, more confident and better-behaved in general.

Nigel truly has a gift with dogs (and owners!).

Nigel was just incredible. I have now seen him twice with my spaniel who is a rescue and suffers with acute anxiety. Nigel was patient and incredibly knowledgeable - I have never been able to get my dog to walk by my heel but after 1 session, Nigel worked miracles and got my wayward dog to be very compliant. I cannot recommend enough for any dog owners struggling and just need the support and tools!

Great experience with Nigel. Advice was specific with simple instructions. Our fox terrier, Capone, has improved significantly since we have implemented Nigel's instructions. I can't recommend him highly enough.

Nigel’s bespoke approach totally transformed the way we understand our dog and the easy to follow techniques have led to our dog being much calmer, more content and less anxious. Nigel is clearly an expert at what he does and gave us the tools and language to resolve the issues we were having and we saw almost instant results. Over the weeks the improvements continued and Nigel was there to support us through this process. I would highly recommend Nigel, he was brilliant and the positive impact on our dog has been game changing!

Meeting with Nigel was amazing! He assessed our young puppy and helped us understand the causes of certain undesirable behaviors and how we should address them. His approach is very intelligent, not just one rule for everything, and he considers the nuances of specific situations as well as our puppy’s individual needs. He’s definitely given us the confidence to train our puppy appropriately, and we’ve already seen incredible improvements in our puppy’s behavior! We’re really excited to continue speaking with Nigel, as he’s genuinely knowledgeable, kind, and patient. We’re over the moon that we enlisted him for help, and highly, highly recommend him and his training approach!

Nigel was everything his reviews lived up to and more. We have a 10 week old puppy and wanted to make sure we were making the right decisions and not setting ourselves up for failure further down the line. We’d read all the books, listened to all the podcasts and watched all the YouTube videos. But real life has a funny way of not going the same way, doesn’t it? So we decided to get in touch with Nigel. His approach just immediately felt right. He was professional and nonjudgmental. He knew straight away the things we needed to work on. As he explained his process and guided us through his methods, everything clicked into place. And from that moment on we’ve felt like much better dog owners because of it. Our puppy is calmer, more confident and happier. And honestly it’s all because we are now calmer, more confident and happier. Nigel might have come to teach the puppy. But really he taught us. He is definitely the dog trainer you’re looking for.

When I contacted Nigel I was at the end of myself with Toffee. My Labrador was attacking other dogs and I was scared to leave the house. Nigel came and was a breath of fresh air. He was sensible kind and quite simply his methods work. In 2 lessons toffee was a changed dog and he showed me workable methods to change her behaviour. He transformed our whole life with toffee and we are all just so grateful to him. Our family could not recommend him enough. It was a complete game changer. Thanks so much Nigel.

Our session with Nigel was excellent. We booked him to come and help with our beloved French Bulldogs who have been quite unsettled after a house move and various major shifts in our routine.

His approach is smart, straight forward, and based on simple principles which felt intuitive and easy to follow.

Beside from all the intriguing theory and animal behaviour psychology, Nigel’s practical approach is excellent. Watching him  get our dogs walking at heel, after years of increasingly chaotic lead-pulling, was quite a revelation.
And then showing us how to help our dogs stop behaving anxiously and aggressively around noisy appliances was another practical example of how effective his approach is.

I would absolutely recommend Dog Training in London with Nigel Reed The Dog Guardian to anybody looking to simply learn more about their animals, or really address serious  issues with their pooch(es).

We recently called Nigel for help on a few specific problems we were having with our adolescent spaniel, Leo (barking at visitors, jumping up at people and chasing our cat).  He responded quickly and was confident that he’d be able to help.  Nigel set us some homework before our meeting (watching some of his training videos) so that we were well prepared and could make the most of our time with him.
Nigel effectively addressed our specific needs; explaining why Leo was behaving the way he was and how we needed to conduct and break down training exercises in order to make them achievable for Leo.
Nigel also took time to clearly explain the ideology behind being the dog’s guardian and the 4 key principles behind his training method.  This was invaluable.  It has aligned my husband’s and my approach to how we look after Leo and by having a greater understanding of Leo’s needs and motivations, we have become better owners.  We are now more able to care for Leo, while setting our own boundaries.
In less than a week Leo is walking so much better on a loose lead, just needing a little correction here and there.  Similarly, his barking and jumping up have been reduced enormously as Leo has come to understand that we will take care of danger for him, while also clearly communicating to him how we expect him to behave.  He is even slowly learning to be calmer around our cat!
The key behind Nigel's method is not so much the training exercises but a shift in attitude in what it means to be a dog's guardian.  By forming these new habits and behaving in this way consistently, I have no doubt that Leo will respond by becoming a happy, confident, well-behaved and calm dog.
Nigel is passionate about dog training and is clearly very knowledgeable about the subject.  He is patient, calm and kind with the owners as well as the dog.  I would not hesitate to call on Nigel again should we need further help and would recommend him to any dog owners needing assistance.
We had the best experience with Nigel, the training he provided us was invaluable, and our daily life has become so much more peaceful and manageable. Highly recommend!

I had got myself and my dog Flo into a situation where she thought that she was the boss of me - demand barking, guarding me and the house and garden and generally needing to be involved in most things I do and it was becoming increasingly problematic.
The session with Nigel was so helpful, and his experience, knowledge and training program has proved to be transformative.
It was so reassuring & confidence building to go through the process with him here in my home where he could observe Flo, and me, and feed back ( without shaming or blaming ) on where and how I was perpetuating her difficult behaviour ( in spite of my good intentions ) He explained the training program - which is incredibly simple, and makes complete sense -  and then guided me through how to how to remedy the situation. We practiced while he was here, with immediate positive effect, and I have been continuing ever since.

Only 2 weeks on and Flo is doing SO well. She is much calmer, more responsive, less anxious, and much less demanding, and I know now that as I continue to remain consistent, confident and calm in all areas of her training and in all areas of her life and needs, this will only get even better.

What I love in particular about Nigel’s style of dog training and his training program is that it is feels very much rooted in a sense and understanding of me being dog’s guardian/steward/protector, as opposed to me being her master or boss or controller.  It feels protective, loving and respectful to Flo and her needs and safety, whilst also ensuring that she is well behaved and calm.
Thank you, Nigel.

I contacted Nigel when we were in crisis with our new dog who we rehomed from a previous owner. Nigel was very quick to respond to my initial email and was extremely communicative throughout the process.

Nigel came to our home and stayed for hours and provided us invaluable reassurance, guidance and training. Right from the start once I had described the issues we were having (our dog Teddy was so scared of everything and completely overwhelmed) Nigel completely understood and sent a number of videos ahead of time for us to watch. Once in our home Nigel was so kind and understanding and worked with us and Teddy to come up with a plan for increasing his confidence. Nigel trains dogs with kindness and positive reinforcement. Nigel was unwaveringly patient with Teddy. It’s no understatement to say that he changed our whole dog owning experience and set us on the right path with Ted. I would recommend him to anyone without hesitation!

We also found Nigel’s book so useful in teaching us the foundations of being good Dog Guardians, and following the simple rules/practises outlined by Nigel has shown us huge results with Ted!

Nigel helped train me to train my dog at a tough point in development: age two brought out some surprising reactivity and even a little aggression in our formerly friendly puppy. It's taken me a few months, but by following his instructions and putting the time in, my dog is back to being far more friendly again. SO important! My Belgian is my companion and I need to trust him out in public with other dogs around!

I can't recommend Nigel enough. My dog has had some issues with separation anxiety, excessive barking and occasional reactivity, and after working with Nigel and applying his teachings, all issues have hugely improved. Nigel is always happy to help and provides continuous support. I had tried other trainers before contacting Nigel and in my opinion nobody has been as helpful and understanding as he has been.  He's the best.

Immediately gave us confidence in what we can do to help our reactive border terrier. Hopeful she will be having lots of positive dog interactions in no time! Would recommend. Best trainer we’ve seen.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Nigel Reed at Dog Training in London, and I can't say enough good things about my experience. From the very beginning, Nigel's expertise and genuine passion for dog training were evident. He has an incredible ability to put you in the mindset of your dog, viewing behaviors and needs from the perspective of dogs in the wild. This unique approach has transformed my understanding of my dog's behavior and deepened our bond.

Nigel's patience, dedication, and clear communication made the training sessions not only effective but also enjoyable. My dog's progress has been remarkable, and I've gained invaluable insights that will benefit us for years to come. If you're looking for top-notch dog training in London, look no further than Nigel Reed. Highly recommended!
